findings.evidence: Phase 4 step 1: "A valid probe always exits 0 and prints exactly `attach` or `branch` on stdout: exactly `attach` is the `attach` mode and exactly `branch` is the `branch` mode (`capability` also falls back to `branch` itself when `gh` is old or unprobeable, with the reason on stderr; checked 2026-11-14)."
findings.fix: Replace the parenthetical with the probe outcomes the script actually prints: forced `PR_DIAGRAMS_MODE` prints that mode and exits 0; an invalid value is a usage error (exit 2, empty stdout); an unreadable or unparseable `gh --version`, a probe timeout, a failed `gh repo view`, or a non-github.com host prints `branch` and exits 0 with the reason on stderr. Keep the stop for a non-zero exit or any other stdout.

findings.evidence: Section 2.2 stops automatic reuse "When that cannot be established" and "A partial merge-commit list is the same stop as no merges", but the only positive test is the example `git log --merges --oneline "origin/$base..origin/$head"`.
findings.fix: State the required check as its own ordered step before any source body is fetched: run `git log --merges --oneline "origin/$base..origin/$head"` and continue only when every selected `SRC` PR appears as a merge into the current head; otherwise stop and ask for `--reuse-from=<PR>`. Keep the squash/rebase warning as the reason.

findings.evidence: The same capability sentence tells the agent a valid probe always exits 0 and that an unprobeable gh falls back to `branch`, which hides the usage-error and empty-stdout stop defined later in the same step.
findings.fix: Add a Gotchas bullet: a non-zero `capability` exit, including an invalid `PR_DIAGRAMS_MODE` or a stray argument, is a stop with empty stdout, never a guessed `branch`; only the script's own exit-0 `branch` lines (old, unreadable or unparseable gh, probe timeout, failed repo view, non-github.com host) are the branch fallback. Point it at phase 4 step 1.

findings.evidence: The command file is 447 lines. Body templates, the none-mode filter, title assembly and branch-publish recovery are loaded from the bundled pr-diagrams reference, but phases 1-6, the mode rules and the recovery ordering remain inline.
findings.fix: Move the phase 4 render probe and the phase 5 attach/publish outcome text into `skills/pr-diagrams/references/pr-body.md` beside "Branch publish and attach recovery", and load that section only when phase 4 enters drawio rendering. Leave phases 1-3 and the mode decision in the command.

findings.evidence: "confirm that the assumption holds: the promotion history shows merge commits (for example `git log --merges ...`) and every `SRC` entry is a PR merged into the current head. When that cannot be established, stop".
findings.fix: Make the merge-commit check the default, not an example: one `git log --merges` command, continue only when every `SRC` entry is listed, and stop otherwise. Do not leave the agent to invent another way to "establish" the assumption.

findings.evidence: Phase 4 says a valid `capability` probe always exits 0, while `skills/pr-diagrams/scripts/pr-diagrams.sh` `usage_err` exits 2 with empty stdout for a stray argument or an invalid `PR_DIAGRAMS_MODE` (`cmd_capability`, usage line: "print attach or branch, always exit 0").
findings.fix: In phase 4 step 1, delete "always exits 0". Say exit 0 with stdout `attach` or `branch` selects that mode, and exit 2 or any other non-zero exit with empty stdout stops the run naming `pr-diagrams.sh capability`. Align the script usage line the same way so the command and the script name one outcome.

findings.evidence: Phase 2 says the final message for a phase 2 terminal failure quotes git's stderr and "Nothing else runs", while section 3 says cleanup "runs on every success and every failure path, after `$AD` exists" and `$AD` is created only in phase 3.
findings.fix: Add one sentence to the phase 2 stop: because `$AD` and the pointer file do not exist yet, phase 6 cleanup is skipped and the early-failure bootstrap removes nothing. Keep "nothing else runs" for reads and PR writes only.
